name: Short 8 - the_real_reason
script: Nokia didn't fail because it was stupid. It failed because it was right for so long that being right became the culture. Success made the company slow, made managers hide bad news, and made leadership miss how far behind the software had fallen. Great hardware couldn't save it, because the problem was never the hardware. So here's the question worth sitting with. What is your thing currently winning at, that's quietly making you deaf to the thing that's coming next?
